caption: The drawing is done in grayscale pencil on a beige or light brown background and features three spoons, depicted in a rectangular framed section in the center of the paper. The leftmost spoon is shown in a front-facing view and has a broad oval bowl with a long handle ending in a slightly squared-off shape. The center spoon is depicted from the side, showing the curvature of the handle and the bowl. The rightmost spoon is also shown from the front, with an oval bowl and a handle that features a decorative end, possibly with ornate patterns or embossed designs. Beneath the main drawing, there is a small diagram presenting a top and side view of one spoon, including some notations and measurements. The shading in the drawing is used to indicate the rounded and metallic nature of the objects, and the composition is arranged symmetrically within the outlined frame. The background outside the frame is plain with some areas of discoloration or age spots.
title: American Pewter Kerfoot
